methodology: Token-generation throughput measured on the hardware above. Values are profile-level reference results, not universal speed claims. Prompt processing and task-level MTP results use separate benchmark runs.

gemma-4-12b-qat-mtp.summary: Fastest profile on this node; native MTP drafting with the official assistant model.

gemma-4-26b-qat-mtp.summary: Current startup preload and the best quality/speed balance in the Gemma set.

gemma-4-26b-qat.summary: Full model without speculative drafting; useful as the MTP control profile.

qwen3-6-mtp.summary: Thinking-enabled MTP profile with strong draft acceptance on coding and factual tasks.

gemma-4-12b-qat.summary: Compact QAT baseline without MTP drafting.

qwen3-6-mtp-vision.summary: Vision-capable Qwen profile with conservative projector headroom and batch sizing.

qwen3-6-mtp-q6.summary: Higher-precision Q6 variant; slower, but useful when Q4 quality is not enough.

qwen3-coder-next.summary: Default coding model with a static, benchmark-derived CPU/GPU expert split.

gemma-4-26b-qat-mtp-vision.summary: 26B QAT profile with MTP drafting and BF16 vision projector.

gemma-4-12b-qat-mtp-vision.summary: Smaller Gemma MTP profile with vision support.

gpt-oss-120b.summary: Reasoning-focused 120B MoE profile with a static expert offload split.

sarvam-30b.summary: Dense Q6 profile running through a custom llama.cpp PR build.

gemma4-12b.title: Gemma 4 12B QAT: baseline vs MTP
gemma4-12b.description: Task-level generation throughput. MTP averaged 120.8 t/s across this run; acceptance varies materially by task.

gemma4-26b.title: Gemma 4 26B QAT: baseline vs MTP
gemma4-26b.description: Task-level MTP run. The 100.6 t/s profile result above comes from a separate optimized throughput run; these rows show how acceptance changes by workload.

qwen3-6-35b.title: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B: baseline vs MTP
qwen3-6-35b.description: Task-level comparison for Qwen3.6 35B. The served profile uses the conservative 60.3 t/s validated configuration; this separate run averaged 68.5 t/s.

archived.name: Gemma 4 26B (standard / non-QAT)
